map.D、S、H 三个参数分别是什么？: What are the three parameters D, S, H?
map.D=计划期（通常一年）内的总需求量；S=每次下单的固定成本（订单处理、运输、验收: D = total demand over the planning period (usually one year); S = fixed cost per order (order processing, shipping, acceptance, etc., independent of batch size); H = holding cost per unit per year (capital, storage, spoilage, etc.). All three must share the same time basis and be greater than 0.
map.EOQ 算出来不是整数怎么办？: What if the EOQ is not an integer?
map.EOQ 是理论最优值，实际订货量应结合包装规格、最小起订量、整数箱数取整；取整后: EOQ is the theoretical optimum; actual order quantity should be rounded to packaging specs, MOQ, or integer boxes; rounding slightly raises total cost but is usually negligible. Too-large batches tie up capital, too-small batches order too often; EOQ gives a balance reference.
